FIELDS.NAME: Beverage Junction
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Compliance Officer, Beverage Junction, 555-123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Beverage Junction operates as a wholesale distributor and retailer of beer, liquor, and wine, offering a diverse selection of beverages to meet the needs of our customers. We maintain compliance with all federal, state, and local alcohol licensing and regulatory requirements to ensure a legal and responsible operation. Our staff undergoes rigorous training in responsible beverage service and age verification procedures to prevent underage sales and minimize liability exposure. We emphasize stringent inventory management practices and conduct regular assessments to maintain strong operational controls. Additionally, our inventory is protected with central alarm systems, as we prioritize security for our high-value products. Our focus remains on dedicated beverage distribution and retail services, aligning with our commitment to quality and reliability in customer service.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Beverage Junction Cafe, a small cafe serving craft beverages and light snacks, located at 456 Beverage Ave, Springfield, IL 62701-5678.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 01/15/2022, a delivery truck carrying inventory was involved in a minor accident due to inclement weather, resulting in damages amounting to $3,000. The claim is currently closed. On 05/10/2023, inventory was reported missing during stock assessment, leading to a total loss of $5,000. This incident is under investigation and the status is open.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Central Station Safe, Class 2, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with regular monitoring and on-site security personnel during high-traffic hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Beverage Junction has not been involved in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in any capacity. Our operations are focused on the distribution and retail of beverages, adhering to all relevant safety and regulatory standards.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Beverage Junction sponsors local athletic teams as part of our community engagement initiatives, promoting health and wellness while strengthening our brand presence in the area.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Certificates are typically checked by the compliance officer to ensure proper coverage is in place.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Beverage Junction has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. Our operations prioritize compliance and integrity.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Beverage Junction has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and have a good standing with our previous insurance carrier.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Beverage Junction does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain a dedicated staff for our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Beverage Junction carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements for our employees, ensuring their protection while they perform their duties.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Beverage Junction also operates a small café called Beverage Junction Cafe, which serves craft beverages and light snacks, located at a different address in Springfield.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Beverage Junction does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All necessary coverage is currently provided under the existing policies.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Beverage Junction is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the wholesale distribution and retail of alcoholic beverages.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Beverage Junction does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus solely on beverage distribution and retail. We ensure all equipment used is for our internal operations.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Beverage Junction has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. We maintain financial stability and compliance with all regulations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Beverage Junction does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in its operations, as we focus solely on the distribution and retail of beverages while adhering to all regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Beverage Junction does not have any catastrophe exposure that would impact our operations or insurance coverage. We maintain a secure environment and adhere to all necessary safety regulations.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Beverage Junction has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize compliance and a safe work environment for all employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Beverage Junction has no uncorrected fire code violations. We maintain compliance with fire safety regulations and regularly conduct inspections to ensure safety standards are met.
